full_judgment:
Mr. Md. Anwarul Haque, J.: One Shamsunnaher complainant of Nari-O-Shishu Nirjatan Daman Case No.74 of 2000 arising out of G.R. Case No.124 of 2000 corresponding to Manda P.S. Case No.14 dated 27.4.2000 punishable under Section 10(1)13 of the Nari-O-Shishu Nirjatan Daman Ain, 2000 has filed this petition of appeal under Section 28 of the said Ain challenging the legality and propriety of the order passed by the learned Judge of the Tribunal on 10.4.2001 accepting the report submitted by the Investigating Office rejecting the naraji petition filed by pl. complainant, the present appellant - o this appeal. 

 3. Yet, today brought into the daily cause list with the name of the learned Advocate and parties when Mr. S.N. Goswami the learned Advocate for the appellant has turned up to press without assigning any cogent reason for long such silence However, the learned Advocate has tried to draw the attention of this court in the affidavit Annexure-C-1, C-2 to the petition of appeal in support of the case of the informant-appellant stated in the F.I.R. and have prayed for admission of appeal for hearing. 

 6. Be the case as it may, since police report filed under Section 173(1) of the Code of 

 Criminal Procedure discloses the commission of cognizable offence the learned Magistrate is at liberty to take cognizance under Section 190 of the Code of Criminal Procedure but it cannot be so done by the learned Judge of the Nari-O-Shishu Nirjatan Daman Adalat. However, 4 since we find no credible evidence to make bout a prima-facie case which may bring within the mischief of section 10(1) or any other section of the Nari-O-Shishu Nirjatan Daman Ain. 2000 we are of the opinion that admission of appeal will surely cause unnecessary harassment of the respondent as such we are not inclined to admit the appeal.
